body: The snapshot's stamp and the report's were both s plus twelve hex and nothing said which was which; all four sixth-trial operators handed the report's to if_stamp and were refused stale, told the page had moved, about a page that had not. A report stamp is r plus twelve hex now; if_stamp handed one is refused invalid_argument before any look, naming both kinds and the fix; observe and read-report handed the other kind answer the whole document and name the kind; the manifest publishes a stamps block. verify_contract 221 to 230, verify_report 248 to 249, mutate_contract 105 to 111, mutate_report 149 to 151. The seventh blind trial -- food web, releve, tree proofs, ethogram, one attempt each, 42 of 69 outcomes and 322 of 370 claims in 216 calls -- shows every wrong-kind if_stamp refused as the wrong kind and corrected on the next move, and zero report stamps answered stale; verify_tasks 411 to 429 holds both numbers. Every operator found the next thing: the observe baseline is one slot deep, so a stamp from any move but the last of a batch is unknown; reproduced, held for the next slice. Filed: tree proofs key 63 reads 6 where the task holds 7; ethogram budget note still says elapsed.
subject: ADR-229: a stamp says which series it is (protocol 1.9) -- and the seventh blind trial, four more pages nobody had driven, measures that nobody is told a page moved when it had not
